CREATE TABLE week_template ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_week_tpl_user_name UNIQUE (user_id, name), CONSTRAINT fk_week_tpl_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
CREATE INDEX idx_week_tpl_user ON week_template (user_id);
